resolution.note: PreToolUse hook scripts/claude/memory-budget.ts (Write|Edit, project settings) refuses MEMORY.md writes over the INDEX-SIZE budget; hook test covers refuse and allow.

title: Enforce the memory index budget when a note is written
body: Outcome: the memory index budget (INDEX-SIZE, scripts/claude/memory-refs.ts:35,182: 2400 bytes or 200 lines) is enforced when a note is written, not only reported at session start: a PreToolUse hook on Write/Edit into the auto-memory directory refuses a write that would push MEMORY.md over budget and names the budget, so the writer consolidates first (write-time cap, as Hermes does; a read-time cap lets stale and current notes coexist, as in Grok Bot's shared pool). Proof: a hook test where an oversize MEMORY.md write exits non-zero and an in-budget write exits 0.
